content:
h11.

**1st: `store.User`** — referenced from ~7 packages outside `store`: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go:61,102,190`, `server/auth/context.go:55`), `server/notification` (`server/notification/email.go:136`), `server/router/api/v1` (e.g. `server/router/api/v1/user_service.go:478`, `common.go:81`), `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver` (`fileserver.go:708`), `server/router/frontend` (`frontend_test.go:183`), and `server/router/rss` (`rss.go:162`).

**2nd: `store.Memo`** — referenced from ~6 packages outside `store`: `server/notification` (`email.go:213`), `server/router/api/v1` (widely used, e.g. `memo_service.go:84`, `memo_service_converter.go:23`), `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend` (`frontend_test.go:190`), `server/router/rss` (`rss.go:162`), and `server/runner/memopayload` (`runner.go:74`).

Method: grepped for `store\.User\b` / `store\.Memo\b` / other entity types (`store.Attachment`, `store.Inbox`, `store.Reaction`, `store.MemoRelation`, `store.MemoShare`, `store.UserIdentity`, `store.IdentityProvider`, `store.InstanceSetting`) across the repo and grouped hits by importing package/directory, excluding the data layer itself (`store/*.go`, `store/db/*`, `store/migration/*`, `store/cache`, `store/test` — all part of or testing the persistence layer). The entity types are defined in `store/*.go` (e.g. `store/user.go:29`, `store/memo.go:35`, `store/attachment.go:16`, `store/inbox.go:24`, etc.), with per-dialect table DDL under `store/migration/{mysql,postgres,sqlite}` (11 tables each per `[ArchMap query]`).

Runner-up types trail well behind: `Attachment` (~4 packages: `api/v1`, `api/v1/test`, `fileserver`, `rss`), `Inbox` (~3: `notification`, `api/v1`, `api/v1/test`), `MemoRelation`/`MemoShare` (~3 each), `Reaction`/`UserIdentity` (~2 each), and `IdentityProvider` (0 direct external Go references found — only consumed via the separate `storepb.IdentityProvider` proto type).
